title: The runtime renders the host-neutral position packet and counts its entries
summary: @inventarch/runtime exports renderPacket(handle, within, catalog) and entryCount(packet) from the package root and the new @inventarch/runtime/internal/packet subpath, with the PositionPacket, PacketCatalogRow, PacketSeat, PacketParticipant, PacketMandate, PacketSystem, PacketTally, PacketIntent, PacketPhase, PacketProvenance, PacketHostNote and PacketOutput types; the root's Packet type is still the context packet. renderPacket calls position once, at K0, through the scope token within, reads everything else through the same token, so a narrowed token leaves out what it does not admit, and returns the frozen {packet, digest, hostNote}. The packet, format ia.position-packet.v1, holds: revision; body, the digest of body(K0); seat, the repository's `@workspace` with its identity, its composition.sources as authored, the count of its composition.systems references and its composition.steward, plus participants 'none (no authored `@mandate` names an `@agent`)' when no participant is rendered; mandates, the band-100 mandates body(K0) lists whose authority.participant resolves to a band-100 `@agent`, by identity, each with its participant and scope, and with its moves, excluded words and covers as authored when it states them (a declared empty moves list renders as an empty list); participants, those agents once each with their meaning.says, by identity (no participant is no refusal); systems, one line per composition.systems reference, by identity, with the words the `@system` record's discriminators rows register, its band, its head.steward and the command ia position --seat <identity>, or unresolved in place of the words and steward for a reference no admitted record in the scope answers; tallies, per word, the band-100 records captured under the seat's own declared roots, none while it declares none; intents, the five shapes in table order with category, primitive, anchor phase, kind, lane and predicate focus, priming order and the registered words each seeds; phases, the four phases with the primitives anchored at each and what --phase changes; commands, the catalog rows passed in, in their order, each copied as {command, mode, move, refuses, next}; lines, the design's three SPEC lines with ia position in place of ia scope; and provenance, {revision, slug}, the slug being the workspace's name, absent when no `@workspace` is declared at the repository root. digest is graph's codec digest of the packet. The host note is position's note plus installed 'unknown (no join checked here)' and is never digested. The packet names no absolute path, scope token, time, capture state or CLI version, and no record at runtime placement is part of it, so copies at two roots give byte-equal packets and digests, and writing a capture changes only the host note. entryCount(packet) is participants + mandates + 1 + systems + tallies + 5 + 4 + commands + 1 + 3; the host note is no entry. The refusals are position's; no admitted record is refused. @inventarch/cli/internal/commands adds the CatalogTag type, an optional catalog {mode, move, refuses, next} on CommandSpec, set on init, validate, capture, read, position and next, and packetCatalog(commands?), which maps the tagged rows to PacketCatalogRow values in table order; the CLI's behaviour and help output are unchanged. Limits: renderHost (@inventarch/runtime/internal/packet-host) renders the packet for the claude and codex hosts, and nothing writes a file; the packet reads the live admitted revision, not a capture; installed state is always unknown; position, body(K) and ia.position-body.v1, MACHINE_PROTOCOL and the Door are unchanged.
